comment: Findings recorded here are excluded from the release image scan gate. Every entry must bind the exact finding it covers - image, package, installed version, and vulnerability id - match the digest-pinned base image the image is actually built from, carry a reason, and stay inside its review_by date; an expired exemption, a new CVE on the same package, or a base image change fails the gate again. Everything else with an available fix at High or Critical still fails the publish.

exemptions.reason: Reviewed cross-channel false positive: https://linux.oracle.com/errata/ELSA-2026-50075.html uses epoch 10 for FIPS packages. Ordinary BaseOS https://linux.oracle.com/errata/ELSA-2026-1473.html fixes the same 12 CVEs in 1:3.5.1-7.0.1.el9_7; installed non-FIPS 1:3.5.8-1.0.1.el9_8 includes those fixes. Both native reports and vendor records independently reviewed. Other advisories remain gated.

The image is pinned to postgres:17.10-bookworm, which upstream has not rebuilt with the Debian libpcre2 10.42-1+deb12u1 security update; moving to a newer PostgreSQL patch line is gated by the database patch review in docs/reference/support-policy.md and must not happen through a scanner-driven base bump. Revisit when the next 17.x patch image adopts the fixed Debian layer.
